claim: RIF-1 has a molecular formula of C32H64NO7S.
source_text: Based on high-resolution mass spectrometry, RIF-1 has a molecular formula of C32H64NO7S
evidence_reasoning: This was determined by high-resolution mass spectrometry analysis.

claim: The planar structure of RIF-1 was revealed by detailed analysis of one- and two-dimensional NMR spectra.
source_text: Detailed analysis of one- and two-dimensional (COSY, HMBC, TOCSY, Figure 3—figure supplements 3–15) nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR, 600 MHz, Table 3) spectra revealed the planar structure of RIF-1
evidence_reasoning: This describes the analytical methods used to determine the structure of RIF-1.

claim: The environmental isolate of Salpingoeca rosetta is deposited at the American Tissue Culture Collection (ATCC) under the designation ATCC50818.
source_text: The environmental isolate of Salpingoeca rosetta is deposited at the American Tissue Culture Collection (ATCC) under the designation ATCC50818
evidence_reasoning: This is factual information about the strain designation, supported by citation to King et al. 2003.

claim: Choanoflagellates could provide particularly important insights into the mechanisms underlying bacterial influences on animal biology and evolution.
source_text: Choanoflagellates, microscopic bacteria-eating eukaryotes that are the closest living relatives of animals (James-Clark 1868; Saville Kent 1880; Hibberd 1975; Carr et al. 2008; King et al. 2008; Ruiz-Trillo et al. 2008), could provide particularly important insights into the mechanisms underlying bacterial influences on animal biology and evolution
evidence_reasoning: This is an inference based on the phylogenetic position of choanoflagellates as the closest living relatives of animals.

claim: Understanding the environmental cues that regulate choanoflagellate colony formation could provide a molecular model for animal multicellularity.
source_text: understanding the environmental cues that regulate choanoflagellate colony formation could provide a molecular model for animal multicellularity
evidence_reasoning: This is an inference based on the evolutionary relationship between choanoflagellates and animals and the presence of multicellular stages in choanoflagellates.

claim: The limited phylogenetic distribution of bacteria capable of inducing rosette colony development suggested that A. machipongonensis and its close relatives may produce a characteristic molecule.
source_text: The limited phylogenetic distribution of bacteria capable of inducing rosette colony development suggested that A. machipongonensis and its close relatives may produce a characteristic molecule that could be identified biochemically
evidence_reasoning: This is an inference from the observation that only certain Bacteroidetes species induce rosette formation.

claim: The complete absence of rosette colonies in RCA cultures provided the basis for a robust bioassay.
source_text: The complete absence of rosette colonies in RCA cultures provided the basis for a robust bioassay that we developed to identify the rosette-inducing molecule(s)
evidence_reasoning: This describes how the RCA cell line was used as a tool for biochemical identification of RIF-1.

claim: This study provides a prototypical example of bacterial sulfonolipids triggering eukaryotic morphogenesis.
source_text: This study provides a prototypical example of bacterial sulfonolipids triggering eukaryotic morphogenesis
evidence_reasoning: This is a conclusion about the significance of the findings, based on the experimental demonstration that RIF-1, a bacterial sulfonolipid, triggers morphogenesis in S. rosetta.
